summary: A web application for Darshit Sheth, a JM Financial advisor certified by AMFI with 12+ years of experience, to promote mutual fund investments for the Indian market and global funds. Key stats: AUM ₹2 Crore, 25+ clients, 4+ years MF investments. Site name: Planinvestgrow.com. Tagline: 'Plan-Invest-Grow'. Location: Vadodara, Gujarat, India. Email: shethdarshit@live.com. Theme: Blue color scheme with professional investor/advisor imagery.
architectural_notes: Target market: Indian investors; content and regulations should reflect Indian financial market context (SEBI, AMC, etc.)
Branding should align with JM Financial identity and Darshit Sheth as advisor
Site name is Planinvestgrow.com; branding should reflect this name
Unique differentiator: Global funds beyond India in addition to domestic Indian market funds
Contact email: shethdarshit@live.com; Location: Vadodara, Gujarat, India
Tagline: Plan-Invest-Grow; Blue color scheme with professional investor/advisor imagery
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Wide-format professional scene with a financial advisor and two investors seated at a desk in a modern office, all in formal business attire, blue-toned lighting with soft gold highlights, suitable as a full-width hero background (hero-professional.dim_1920x1080.png)
- Professional headshot-style portrait of a male financial advisor in a dark navy business suit against a soft blue gradient background, confident expression (advisor-portrait.dim_600x600.png)

existing_features.title: Create a professional landing/home page that prominently features Darshit Sheth's name, title ('Certified Financial Advisor – Indian Market'), 14 years of experience, and his association with JM Financial. Include a hero section with a strong call-to-action button inviting visitors to 'Start Investing Today' or 'Book a Free Consultation'.

Build a 'Why Invest in Mutual Funds' section explaining the benefits of mutual fund investments tailored to the Indian market (e.g., SIP options, tax-saving ELSS funds, diversification, SEBI regulation, long-term wealth creation). Present benefits as visually distinct cards or icon-driven items.

Create a mutual fund product/category listing section showcasing major fund categories available through JM Financial relevant to the Indian market (e.g., Equity Funds, Debt Funds, Hybrid Funds, ELSS/Tax Saver Funds, SIP Plans). Each category card should show a brief description, key feature tags, and a 'Know More / Invest Now' button.

Build a lead capture / investor inquiry form that collects the investor's full name, email, phone number, city, preferred fund category (dropdown), estimated investment amount range (dropdown), and a short message. On submission, the data is saved to the backend and a success confirmation message is shown to the user.

Create a simple admin/advisor dashboard page (accessible via a dedicated route, no authentication required for initial build) where Darshit Sheth can view a table of all submitted investor leads including their name, contact info, city, fund interest, amount range, and submission date.

Apply a professional, trust-inspiring visual theme across the entire application. Use a color palette evoking financial stability and Indian market warmth — such as deep navy or forest green as primary, with gold/amber accents. Typography should be clean and modern. Layout should feel premium and authoritative, suitable for a certified financial advisor's platform.
Update Darshit Sheth's contact phone number to 9725501285 wherever it appears across the site, including the Footer component and any other components that display contact details.
Update the 'Assets Under Management' stat to '₹10 Crore' in all components where this statistic is displayed, including the HeroSection and AdvisorProfile components.
Update the 'Managing Clients' stat to '150+' in all components where this statistic is displayed, including the HeroSection and AdvisorProfile components.

Update all advisor credential displays site-wide to reflect: AMFI Certified (MF Certified by AMFI), 12+ years of experience (replacing any '14 years' references), AUM ₹2 Crore (replacing '₹10 Crore'), 25+ clients (replacing '150+'), and 4+ years in MF investments. Apply these changes across HeroSection, AdvisorProfile, Footer, Navigation, and any other component that displays these stats.

Update the site title/branding name to 'Planinvestgrow' across the entire application — including the HTML page title (index.html), Navigation logo/brand name, Footer branding, and any other location where the site or app name appears (e.g., 'JM Financial - Mutual Fund Advisor' in the page title).

Add a 'Global Funds' highlight as a unique selling point section or prominent card on the site. This should communicate that Darshit Sheth offers mutual fund investment options beyond India — including international/global funds — which differentiates him from typical Indian MF advisors. This can be a dedicated section on the HomePage, a featured card in FundCategoriesSection, or a highlighted banner. Include a brief description of the benefit of global diversification.

Update the site-wide color theme from forest-green/gold to a professional blue palette. Replace all green-based primary colors in index.css, tailwind.config.js, and all components with deep navy/royal blue as the primary color and gold/amber as accent. Ensure buttons, gradients, section backgrounds, card borders, and badge colors all use the new blue palette consistently across Navigation, HeroSection, AdvisorProfile, FundCategoriesSection, WhyInvestSection, LeadForm, Footer, and DashboardPage.

Add a dedicated 'Unique Investment Strategy: Global Funds Beyond India' section on the HomePage. This section should highlight the tagline 'Plan-Invest-Grow', explain Darshit Sheth's unique approach of offering international/global mutual fund options beyond Indian markets, and present 2–3 key differentiators (e.g., global diversification, access to international growth, USD-denominated assets). Style it as a premium full-width banner or feature section that visually stands out from the rest of the page.

Update the email address to shethdarshit@live.com and location to 'Vadodara, Gujarat, India' in all components where contact details appear — including Footer, AdvisorProfile, LeadForm (placeholder or pre-filled city hint), and any other component displaying email or location.

Replace the HeroSection background with a generated professional image showing a financial advisor and investors in professional business attire. Also add a professional advisor portrait image in the AdvisorProfile section. Both images should use the blue color tone consistent with the site theme. Render these as static assets from frontend/public/assets/generated.

Display the tagline 'Plan-Invest-Grow' prominently in the Navigation logo area (alongside the Planinvestgrow brand name), in the HeroSection, and in the Footer. Ensure it is styled as a distinct tagline (smaller than the brand name, possibly in gold/amber accent color).
